info.title: Mistvale Admin API
info.description: The Admin API the Mistvale Admin Suite consumes, plus the public content bundle it previews. Generated from the Zod contracts in @mistvale/shared — edit those, then run `pnpm openapi`.

post.description: Destroys everything the account has played — champions, relics, items, campaign and Depths progress, the Chronicle, shop stock, summon history, battles, its arena standing and its Hall of Valor — and puts it back at level 1 with the starter chooser waiting. The account keeps its name, password and rank: this is a reset, not a deletion. Settings survive (accessibility choices are not progress), and the wallet is emptied through RewardService so `economy_log` still balances. Irreversible, and every session is signed out.
